refnamediv.refpurpose: Prony's method for time-domain design of IIR Filters.

listitem.para: Impulse response of the digital filter (vector).

refsection.title: Description
refsection.para: The `prony` function designs an IIR filter using Prony's method. It computes the coefficients of the numerator (`b`) and denominator (`a`) of the transfer function (TF) based on the given impulse response `h`, number of zeros `nb`, and number of poles `na`.
Notes - The function zero-pads the input `h` if its length is less than `max(nb, na) + 1`. - The method avoids division by zero by normalizing the first element of `h`.
